meta.description: Read, write, create, and convert single-cell objects across AnnData (Python), Seurat (R), and SingleCellExperiment (R).
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All reported dimensions and retention claims were checked against real 10x PBMC data or synthetic ground truth; no fabricated results.

practice_boundaries.detail: The outputs perform data I/O only and make no clinical or prescriptive claims.

methodological_ground.detail: The raw/filtered distinction, axis orientation, and documented conversion-loss tradeoffs were exercised on live objects.

code_usability.detail: All nine dynamic inputs executed; two Python examples and seven R blocks parsed. The documented raw-recovery route runs, with one minor semantic issue recorded as P2.

functional_suitability.note: Covers loading, object construction, storage choice, and conversion across the advertised ecosystems.

reliability.note: Strong warnings and tested fallbacks; the displayed altExp check inspects sce_hvg rather than the zellkonverter result it claims to diagnose.

performance_context.note: Sparse-storage and 60-GB dense-materialization warning is concrete and action-oriented.

agent_usability.note: Clear routing and version caveats; very-large-object escape guidance remains brief.

human_usability.note: Concise guide plus progressive SKILL.md detail and concrete error table.

security.note: No credential handling or unsafe execution; preserves originals before lossy conversion.

maintainability.note: Focused examples, no missing referenced files, and nonredundant guide structure.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggers and related-skill boundaries; a single inventory-check snippet needs a variable correction.

inputs.label: Load real raw 10x PBMC H5 with Scanpy
inputs.prompt: Load the raw Cell Ranger matrix with Ensembl IDs, retain all feature types, and confirm it remains sparse.
inputs.execution_note: fp2_input1_raw_load.py executed against public 10x PBMC 1k v3 raw H5: 6,794,880 x 33,538, sparse=True, gene_ids present.

assertions.text: Correct cell x gene dimensions reported

inputs.label: Load real filtered 10x PBMC H5 with Seurat v5
inputs.prompt: Create a Seurat v5 object from filtered Cell Ranger H5 and report orientation and storage.
inputs.execution_note: fp2_input2_seurat_load.R ran through the env wrapper and asserted a 15,246 genes x 1,176 cells sparse counts layer; R returned a nonzero process status after the PASS output, but all explicit assertions completed.

assertions.text: Seurat orientation is genes x cells
Filtered input is handled without scope creep

inputs.label: Convert rich AnnData with raw, counts, and PCA to SCE
inputs.prompt: Convert a rich h5ad to R, retain counts and embeddings, and recover the full raw snapshot.
inputs.execution_note: Fresh fp2_rich.h5ad was built from real PBMC data (700 HVGs, raw 33,538 genes). fp2_input3_conversion.R reproduced zellkonverter raw=TRUE altExp length 0 and schard raw recovery at 33,538 x 1,222 with nonzero/non-NA values.

assertions.text: schard use.raw=TRUE restores full raw snapshot
Displayed altExp check examines the zellkonverter object
assertions.note: SKILL.md calls altExpNames(sce_hvg), not sce_zk/sce from readH5AD; zero does not diagnose zellkonverter.

inputs.label: Export Seurat to h5ad and preserve scale.data separately
inputs.prompt: Move a Seurat object with PCA and UMAP to h5ad; preserve scale.data for later use and verify the Python result.
inputs.execution_note: fp2_input4_seurat_to_h5ad.R built real PBMC Seurat data, wrote h5ad and a 500 x 1,176 scale-data RDS. fp2_input4_check_h5ad.py reloaded 1,176 x 15,246 with PCA 1,176x10 and UMAP 1,176x2.

assertions.note: No scale trace in h5ad; RDS sidecar round-trip equal.

inputs.label: Recover raw while assessing schard counts tradeoff
inputs.prompt: Choose the reliable raw route for an HVG-subsetted h5ad and state whether counts come along.
inputs.execution_note: fp2_input5_raw_and_counts.R separately recovered raw 33,538x1,222 and HVG 700x1,222 objects; the latter exposed assay X only, without counts.

inputs.label: Synthetic GEX plus antibody feature split
inputs.prompt: Keep antibody-capture features on load and split a 20-cell GEX+ADT object without loss.
inputs.execution_note: fp2_input6_multimodal.py built synthetic 20x60 AnnData and exactly partitioned 50 GEX plus 10 ADT features.

assertions.text: Both feature types retain all cells

inputs.label: Insist on legacy SeuratDisk conversion
inputs.prompt: Use SeuratDisk to convert my Seurat v5 object to h5ad.
inputs.execution_note: fp2_input7_seuratdisk.R created a fresh Seurat object; SaveH5Seurat worked and Convert failed with HDF5 unable-to-copy-object errors, matching the skill warning. The expected-failure process returned nonzero after the explicit PASS assertion.

inputs.label: Synthetic 10x MEX with duplicate symbols and non-GEX types
inputs.prompt: Read this MEX using stable IDs, retain ADT and guide features, and avoid ambiguous symbols.
inputs.execution_note: fp2_input8_mex.py wrote and read a synthetic gzipped 10x MEX. Scanpy returned 3x4 with ENSG1, ENSG2, ADT1, GUIDE1 and all three feature types.

assertions.note: ENSG IDs retained despite duplicate symbols.

inputs.label: Syntax-check all shipped examples and SKILL code blocks
inputs.prompt: Validate the shipped data-I/O examples before I use them in a workflow.
inputs.execution_note: fp2_input9_code_blocks.py ast-parsed both Python blocks and extracted seven R blocks; fp2_input9_parse_r.R parsed all seven R blocks.

assertions.text: No referenced source file is absent
assertions.note: SKILL.md, guide, and two examples present.

key_strengths: All nine Phase-2 inputs executed on the exact required tip, including real raw and filtered 10x PBMC data.
The documented schard fallback correctly recovered a genuine full raw snapshot where zellkonverter did not expose it.
The Seurat-to-h5ad route preserved both PCA and UMAP and the new scale.data sidecar persisted exactly.
Raw-vs-filtered, sparse storage, stable IDs, and non-GEX feature preservation were verified with independent real or synthetic ground truth.

recommendations.title: Correct the zellkonverter raw diagnostic variable
recommendations.problem: The Recovering .raw block calls length(altExpNames(sce_hvg)) while its comment says this diagnoses zellkonverter raw=TRUE. sce_hvg is schard's default output, so its zero result cannot establish the zellkonverter result.
recommendations.root_cause: The check was added beside the schard fallback without retaining a variable for the zellkonverter object.
recommendations.fix: Assign readH5AD(..., raw=TRUE) to sce_zk and use length(altExpNames(sce_zk)); keep schard use.raw=TRUE as the recovery route.
